message.content: Alice's `solar_research.md` proposes a dense technical breakdown of 2026 cell architectures, but launching straight into lab benchmarks in the Executive Summary will cause reader drop-off before they ever reach the market trends. I would reframe the document structure to lead with an infographic-driven executive dashboard comparing commercial vs. lab efficiency side-by-side, provided we verify that the target audience actually prioritizes commercial ROI over emerging tech potential.
